runtime: Python HTTPS client to local Node Hono; remote synthetic v2 D1 and Vectorize
limitations: Hono runs in local Node over verified loopback HTTPS; stores are actual remote synthetic v2 services. This is not a deployed Workers/Lambda/SQS full E2E.

Vectorize physical and ANN visibility are observed before asserting search success; fixture rows and physical/ANN entries are checked absent after cleanup.
externalTaskCleanupScope: Exact synthetic video ID DELETE awaited; no external queue dispatcher invoked
